messages:
maria_ae: Heads-up: FinSys wants a short POC benchmark next Tue to validate cost and 95/99 latency at 200 qps with one 45s spike to 1k qps. Need to confirm run recipe, infra, and deliverables.

sam_soleng: We can do this in sales-dedicated-3. Confirm model and average token lengths? Also streaming preference and KV cache policy?

maria_ae: Model: open-llama-7b. Prompt ~320 tokens, completion ~80. Streaming enabled. KV cache: mem-only, zero persistence between sessions.

jordan_ml: I'll prepare two replay sets: "context-heavy" (long prompt, short reply) and "decode-heavy" (short prompt, long reply). Will include a small set of cold-start queries to capture compile times.

sam_soleng: Proposed sequence (compact):
- warmup 10m @ 30 qps
- ramp 20m -> 200 qps
- steady A 2h @ 200 qps (context-heavy)
- spike 45s -> 1000 qps
- steady B 2h @ 200 qps (decode-heavy)
- cooldown 10m
Can run in one 6h window.

maria_ae: FinSys asked for token-level cost per 1M tokens and a simple comparison table Hosted vs Reserved (assume 3/6/12mo commits). Also want GPU util and tail-latency charts.

ravi_product: I'll compute cost after we capture tokens/sec and effective batching. I need GPU-hour rate from finance; if not available I'll use internal estimate and mark assumptions.

alyssa_security: Security checklist: redact PII in logs, customer-managed KMS option, retention default 30d but can set 0 for POC, KV cache mem-only. I'll draft a short memo for the questionnaire.

sam_soleng: Draft run command (will finalize before run):
./bench --url=https://dedicated.sales.redwood/v1/generate \
  --model=open-llama-7b --qps=200 --dur=14400 --streaming=true \
  --replay=s3://redwood-poc/finsys/replays/context-heavy.json \
  --kv-cache=memonly --prom=http://prom:9090 --redact-logs=true

deploy-bot: Reservation requested: pool=sales-dedicated-3, nodes=4, window=2026-01-06T09:00:00-17:00:00. Status: pending.

ops-bot: Note: will disable host swap and ensure ephemeral NVMe for temp files. No egress to public S3 buckets except results bucket.

jordan_ml: I'll upload replays and a README to s3://redwood-poc/finsys/1773456789/ by EOD Friday. Also add Grafana panels and PromQL snippets.

maria_ae: Timeline: FinSys prefers Tue 2026-01-06 09:00-15:00 PT. If we can meet that, I'll send invites and request a 30m exec readout same day.

sam_soleng: No infra blockers. I'll confirm reservation and post final commands 2h before the run.

ravi_product: Deliverables: 1) 2-page exec summary with SLO pass/fail and cost-per-1M tokens, 2) detailed appendix with latency histograms, GPU util, and pricing break-even, 3) raw metrics tarball. Aim to deliver within 24h.

maria_ae: Action items recap: sam finalize infra+commands; jordan upload replays+dashboards; alyssa security memo+questionnaire answers; ravi assemble report. I'll confirm with FinSys once reservation is approved. :white_check_mark:
